# MOSSIN LAUNDRY CITY - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Premium, modern laundry service website with luxury dark theme, gold and deep blue colors, built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Branding Guidelines
- **Brand Name**: MOSSIN LAUNDRY CITY
- **Theme**: Luxury dark theme (black/dark navy background)
- **Primary Colors**: Gold (#D4AF37), Deep Blue (#0A3D62)
- **Fonts**: Poppins, Montserrat (sans-serif)
- **Style**: Clean, elegant, futuristic, high-end

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion (animations)
- Responsive design

## Key Sections
1. Hero Section
2. Services
3. How It Works
4. Gallery
5. Pricing
6. Testimonials
7. Contact & Booking
8. Footer

## Development
- Run `npm run dev` to start development server
- Access at http://localhost:3000
